import importlib.metadata as md,json,os
from pathlib import Path
assert 'SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION' not in os.environ
assert os.environ['SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_YPRICEMAGIC']=='0.0.0'
assert md.version('ypricemagic')=='0.0.0'
Path('/reports/version-scope.json').write_text(json.dumps({'complete':True,'application_version':md.version('ypricemagic'),'dependency_versions':{name:md.version(name) for name in ['ez-a-sync','mypy','eth-brownie']},'global_override_present':False},indent=2)+'\n')
